name: Accounts Payable Trial Balance Drift
query:
SELECT
    gl.account AS "Account:Link/Account:280",
    gl.company AS "Company:Link/Company:160",
    ROUND(SUM(gl.debit - gl.credit), 2) AS "Balance (Dr-Cr):Float:160",
    COUNT(*) AS "GL Entries:Int:100"
FROM `tabGL Entry` gl
WHERE gl.is_cancelled = 0
  AND (gl.account LIKE '%%Creditors%%' OR gl.account LIKE '%%Credit Card Clearing%%' OR gl.account LIKE '%%Unmapped Card Spend%%')
GROUP BY gl.account, gl.company
ORDER BY gl.company, gl.account
